const storage = getSourcepointStorage();
return {
event_id: `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
captured_at: new Date().toISOString(),
trigger: ctx.trigger,
message_type: ctx.messageType ?? '',
sourcepoint: buildSourcepointMeta(),
gdpr: buildConsent(CONSENT_SCHEMA.gdpr, ctx, storage),
usnat: buildConsent(CONSENT_SCHEMA.usnat, ctx, storage),
user_ids: buildUserIds(),
page: {
url: window.location.href,
hostname: window.location.hostname,
path: window.location.pathname,
referrer: document.referrer ?? '',
},
callback_data: {
choice_id: normalizeString(ctx.choiceId),
choice_type_id: normalizeString(ctx.choiceTypeId),
info_json: safeJsonStringify(ctx.info),
},
};
};
const hasShardedUuid = ({ gdpr, usnat }) =>
Boolean(gdpr?.uuid?.includes('_') || usnat?.uuid?.includes('_'));
const isFreyrEnabled = () => Boolean(window.vanilla?.featureFlags?.freyr?.enabled);
const ensureFreyrQueue = () => {
window.freyr = window.freyr || { cmd: [] };
if (!Array.isArray(window.freyr.cmd)) {
window.freyr.cmd = [];
}
};
const send = (payload) => {
if (!isFreyrEnabled()) {
console.warn(...LOG_BADGE, 'Sourcepoint consent event dropped: Freyr disabled');
return;
}
ensureFreyrQueue();
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'sourcepointConsentCapturedEvent',
eventObject: payload,
});
};
const captureAndSend = (ctx, attempt = 0) => {
const payload = buildPayload(ctx);
const shouldRetry =
ctx.trigger === 'CONSENT_EVENT_TRIGGER_ON_MESSAGE_CHOICE_SELECT' &&
attempt < MAX_SHARD_RETRIES &&
!hasShardedUuid(payload);
if (shouldRetry) {
window.setTimeout(() => captureAndSend(ctx, attempt + 1), SHARD_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
return;
}
send(payload);
};
window.fteSourcepointConsentEvent = {
captureAndSend: (ctx = {}) => {
try {
captureAndSend(ctx, 0);
} catch (error) {
console.warn(
...LOG_BADGE,
'Sourcepoint consent event failed',
error?.message ?? error,
);
}
},
};
})();
</script>

if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value) return null;

return JSON.parse(value);
} catch {
return null;
}

const safeJsonStringify = (value) => {
try {
return JSON.stringify(value ?? {});
} catch {

}

}

{

],
consent_string: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['gdpr', 'euconsent']),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.gdpr.euconsent` : '',
},
{
value: ctx.messageType === 'gdpr' ? (ctx.euconsent ?? null) : null,

},
{ value: getCookie('euconsent-v2'), source: 'cookie.euconsent-v2' },
],
applies: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{

{

},

uuid: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{

applies: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: normalizeBoolean(getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'applies'])),

window.bordeaux = window.bordeaux || {};
window.bordeaux.cmd = window.bordeaux.cmd || [];
window.champagne = window.champagne || {};
window.champagne.cmd = window.champagne.cmd || [];
window.ffte.bordeaux ={
pageTemplate: "listing",
adParameters: window.adParameters || {"site":"theweek-progressive","content":"unknown","type":"unsponsored-listing"}
};
(function() {
const QA_BASE_URL = 'public.rtb-qa-eks-euw1.futureplc.engineering';
const createScriptTag = (src) => {
const script = document.createElement('script');
script.setAttribute('src', src);
script.setAttribute('onerror', 'handleHeaderError()');
script.setAttribute('crossorigin', 'anonymous');
script.defer = true;
return script;
};
const appendScriptTags = (qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion) => {
if (window.disableBordeaux === true) return;
const bordeauxUrl = qaBordeauxVersion
? `https://bordeaux.futurecdn.net/bordeaux.js?version=${qaBordeauxVersion}`
: 'https://bordeaux.futurecdn.net/bordeaux.js';
const champagneUrl = qaChampagneVersion
? `https://chmp.${qaChampagneVersion}.${QA_BASE_URL}/champagne.js`
: 'https://champagne.futurecdn.net/champagne.js';
document.head.append(
createScriptTag(bordeauxUrl),
createScriptTag(champagneUrl)
);
};
const getQueryParams = () => {
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
return {
qaBordeauxVersion: params.get('hybrid_bordeaux_version') ?? null,
qaChampagneVersion: params.get('hybrid_champagne_version') ?? null,
};
};
const { qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion } = getQueryParams();
appendScriptTags(qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion);
if (qaBordeauxVersion) {
window.bordeaux.cmd.push(() => window.bordeaux.setAdToolVersion(qaBordeauxVersion));
}
})();
</script>

const MAX_SHARD_RETRIES = 3;
const SHARD_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 250;
const safeJsonParse = (value) => {
if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value) return null;

return JSON.parse(value);
} catch {

}

const safeJsonStringify = (value) => {

return match ? safeDecode(match[1]) : null;

const getStorage = (key) => {
try {
return window.localStorage?.getItem(key) ?? null;
} catch {

}

null;

if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
if (value === 'true') return true;
if (value === 'false') return false;
return null;
};
const normalizeString = (value) => {
if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';

};

: null;
const candidateKeys = new Set(preferred ? [preferred] : []);
try {
const ls = window.localStorage;
if (ls) {
for (let i = 0; i < ls.length; i += 1) {

if (key?.startsWith(CONSENT_STORAGE_PREFIX)) candidateKeys.add(key);

{

{
value: ctx.messageType === 'gdpr' ? (ctx.consentUUID ?? null) : null,

},
{ value: getCookie('consentUUID'), source: 'cookie.consentUUID' },
],
consent_string: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['gdpr', 'euconsent']),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.gdpr.euconsent` : '',
},
{
value: ctx.messageType === 'gdpr' ? (ctx.euconsent ?? null) : null,
source: 'onConsentReady.euconsent',
},
{ value: getCookie('euconsent-v2'), source: 'cookie.euconsent-v2' },
],
applies: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: normalizeBoolean(getPath(storage.value, ['gdpr', 'applies'])),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.gdpr.applies` : '',
},
{
value:
ctx.messageType === 'gdpr'
? normalizeBoolean(getPath(ctx.info, ['applies']))
: null,
source: 'onConsentReady.info.applies',
},
],
},
usnat: {
uuid: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'uuid']),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.usnat.uuid` : '',
},
{
value: ctx.messageType === 'usnat' ? (ctx.consentUUID ?? null) : null,
source: 'onConsentReady.consentUUID',
},
{ value: getCookie('usnatUUID'), source: 'cookie.usnatUUID' },
],
consent_string: ({ storage }) => [
{
value: getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'consentString']),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.usnat.consentString` : '',
},
],
applies: ({ storage, ctx }) => [
{
value: normalizeBoolean(getPath(storage.value, ['usnat', 'applies'])),
source: storage.key ? `${storage.key}.usnat.applies` : '',
},
{
value:
ctx.messageType === 'usnat'

<script type="text/javascript">
(function() {
const CS_CONFIG = {
id: '124b1372e60d2',
siteKey: 'theweek',
subsets: [{"conditions":{"path":"\/"},"sampleRate":1,"sessionTracking":true}],
sessionStorageKey: 'cs_session_theweek'
};
const hasSessionFlag = () => {
return sessionStorage.getItem(CS_CONFIG.sessionStorageKey) === 'true';
};
const setSessionFlag = () => {
sessionStorage.setItem(CS_CONFIG.sessionStorageKey, 'true');
};
/**
* Checks if the current page matches a subset's conditions.
* Matches can be based on URL path or article ID.
*/
const matchesSubset = (subset) => {
const currentArticleId = null;
// Check if path condition matches current URL pathname
if (subset.conditions.path && window.location.pathname === subset.conditions.path) {
return true;
}
// Check if articleId condition matches current article ID
if (subset.conditions.articleId && currentArticleId) {
const articleIds = Array.isArray(subset.conditions.articleId) ? subset.conditions.articleId : [subset.conditions.articleId];
return articleIds.includes(currentArticleId);
}
return false;
};
const isInSample = (subset, subsetIndex) => {
const sampleRate = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, subset.sampleRate || 1));
const storageKey = `cs_sample_${CS_CONFIG.siteKey}_${subsetIndex}`;
const persistedSample = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
if (persistedSample) {
return persistedSample === 'true';
}
// Determine if user is in sample based on random chance and sample rate
// Store the decision in localStorage for future page loads
const isSampled = Math.random() * 100 <= sampleRate;
localStorage.setItem(storageKey, isSampled ? 'true' : 'false');
return isSampled;
};
const initContentSquare = (isInitialLoad = false) => {
if (!Array.isArray(window._uxa)) {
window._uxa = [];
}
// Build the path with hash converted to query parameter format
const path = `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.hash.replace('#', '?__')}`;
window._uxa.push([isInitialLoad ? 'setPath' : 'trackPageview', path]);
if (typeof window.CS_CONF === 'undefined') {
const mt = document.createElement("script");
mt.type = "text/javascript";
mt.async = true;
mt.src = `//t.contentsquare.net/uxa/${CS_CONFIG.id}.js`;
document.getElementsByTagName("head")[0].appendChild(mt);
}
};
const checkAndInitCS = () => {
if (hasSessionFlag()) {
initContentSquare(false);
return;
}
const matchedIndex = CS_CONFIG.subsets.findIndex((subset, index) =>
matchesSubset(subset) && isInSample(subset, index)
);
if (matchedIndex !== -1) {
const subset = CS_CONFIG.subsets[matchedIndex];
// Set session flag only if sessionTracking is enabled for this subset
// This flag will persist for the browser tab session and enable tracking on all pages
if (subset.sessionTracking) {
setSessionFlag();
}
initContentSquare(true);
return;
}
};
checkAndInitCS();
window.initContentSquare = checkAndInitCS;
})();

window.freyr = window.freyr || { cmd: [] };
if (!Array.isArray(window.freyr.cmd)) {
window.freyr.cmd = [];
}
};
const send = (payload) => {
if (!isFreyrEnabled()) {
console.warn(...LOG_BADGE, 'Sourcepoint consent event dropped: Freyr disabled');
return;
}
ensureFreyrQueue();
window.dispatchOrQueueAction('freyr.sendEventToFreyr', {
name: 'sourcepointConsentCapturedEvent',
eventObject: payload,
});
};
const captureAndSend = (ctx, attempt = 0) => {
const payload = buildPayload(ctx);
const shouldRetry =
ctx.trigger === 'CONSENT_EVENT_TRIGGER_ON_MESSAGE_CHOICE_SELECT' &&
attempt < MAX_SHARD_RETRIES &&
!hasShardedUuid(payload);
if (shouldRetry) {
window.setTimeout(() => captureAndSend(ctx, attempt + 1), SHARD_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
return;
}
send(payload);
};
window.fteSourcepointConsentEvent = {
captureAndSend: (ctx = {}) => {
try {
captureAndSend(ctx, 0);
} catch (error) {
console.warn(
...LOG_BADGE,
'Sourcepoint consent event failed',
error?.message ?? error,
);
}
},
};
})();

{

window.bordeaux = window.bordeaux || {};
window.bordeaux.cmd = window.bordeaux.cmd || [];
window.champagne = window.champagne || {};
window.champagne.cmd = window.champagne.cmd || [];
window.ffte.bordeaux ={
pageTemplate: "listing",
adParameters: window.adParameters || {"site":"theweek-progressive","content":"unknown","type":"unsponsored-listing"}
};
(function() {
const QA_BASE_URL = 'public.rtb-qa-eks-euw1.futureplc.engineering';
const createScriptTag = (src) => {
const script = document.createElement('script');
script.setAttribute('src', src);
script.setAttribute('onerror', 'handleHeaderError()');
script.setAttribute('crossorigin', 'anonymous');
script.defer = true;
return script;
};
const appendScriptTags = (qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion) => {
if (window.disableBordeaux === true) return;
const bordeauxUrl = qaBordeauxVersion
? `https://bordeaux.futurecdn.net/bordeaux.js?version=${qaBordeauxVersion}`
: 'https://bordeaux.futurecdn.net/bordeaux.js';
const champagneUrl = qaChampagneVersion
? `https://chmp.${qaChampagneVersion}.${QA_BASE_URL}/champagne.js`
: 'https://champagne.futurecdn.net/champagne.js';
document.head.append(
createScriptTag(bordeauxUrl),
createScriptTag(champagneUrl)
);
};
const getQueryParams = () => {
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
return {
qaBordeauxVersion: params.get('hybrid_bordeaux_version') ?? null,
qaChampagneVersion: params.get('hybrid_champagne_version') ?? null,
};
};
const { qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion } = getQueryParams();
appendScriptTags(qaBordeauxVersion, qaChampagneVersion);
if (qaBordeauxVersion) {
window.bordeaux.cmd.push(() => window.bordeaux.setAdToolVersion(qaBordeauxVersion));
}
})();
</script>
